address: Am Anger 1, Nußdorf am Attersee, 4865, Austria
bio: An establishment that is a delight in every respect! The fantastic lakeside location by Attersee alone makes a visit worthwhile, as does the pleasingly relaxed atmosphere, which combines rural charm with more modern features, as well as the beautiful terrace. And then there's the cuisine, which has classic Austrian roots. The dishes that grace the menu are tasty and prepared without much ado - Wiener schnitzel made from saddle of veal or half a roast chicken; the odd Mediterranean influence also makes its presence felt. Many of the wines on the 500-plus list are from Austria. The Hotel Aichinger has attractive, modern guestrooms for overnight stays....
